id: cuad:SightLife Surgical, Inc. - STRATEGIC SALES _ MARKETING AGREEMENT

findings.quoted_text: Surgical agrees that all Work Product shall be the sole and exclusive property of Imprimis.

Within sixty (60) days after the end of each calendar quarter during the Term, Imprimis shall deliver to Surgical a report setting forth for such calendar quarter the calculation of the applicable Sales Commission due under this Agreement for the sale of the Product (as defined in the SOW).
Surgical agrees that all Work Product shall be the sole and exclusive property of Imprimis.
findings.explanation: Intellectual property ownership of your work transfers to the client immediately upon creation, before you have been paid.
findings.suggested_change: Upon receipt of full payment, all right, title, and interest in the Work Product shall transfer to the Client.

findings.quoted_text: Within sixty (60) days after the end of each calendar quarter during the Term, Imprimis shall deliver to Surgical a report setting forth for such calendar quarter the calculation of the applicable Sales Commission due under this Agreement for the sale of the Product (as defined in the SOW).
findings.explanation: Payment is delayed for 60 days following the end of each calendar quarter, which significantly ties up your cash flow compared to standard 30-day terms.
findings.suggested_change: Within thirty (30) days following the end of each calendar month, the Client shall deliver the applicable report and remit full payment of all commissions due.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello. I have reviewed the agreement and would like to suggest a few updates before signing: - Regarding the relevant clause on intellectual property, the terms transfer ownership before payment is received, and I propose modifying it so that the transfer occurs upon receipt of full payment. - Regarding the relevant clause on payment timelines, the schedule delays payment for sixty days following the end of each calendar quarter, and I propose updating this to thirty days following the end of each calendar month for the report and payment. Thank you for your time and best wishes.
